clue.text: Runs in puffed, having caught on

indicators.note: in places the cricket abbreviation inside the word for puffed

parts.note: puffed, out of breath, means gasped
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A breathless runner finally grasped the idea while panting.
explanation.definitionFit: To have caught on to an idea is to have understood or seized it mentally.

clue.text: Gone off setter? It's the chromosomes!

indicators.note: off, gone bad, signals the letters of gone are rearranged

parts.note: the setter refers to themself as me

explanation.surface: The setter has gone mad, exclaiming about chromosomes.
explanation.definitionFit: A genome is the full set of genetic material carried on an organism's chromosomes.

clue.text: Missing son adopted by a criminal

indicators.note: adopted by places the son within, as an adopted child is taken into a family

parts.note: bent is slang for crooked or criminal

explanation.surface: A lost boy is taken in by a crook.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone absent is missing, not present.

clue.text: They reveal lies in old college charts

parts.note: a poly was a polytechnic, a type of British college that was later given university status
charts are graphs

explanation.surface: Falsehoods are exposed in diagrams from a former college.
explanation.definitionFit: Polygraphs are lie detectors, machines that expose falsehoods.

clue.text: Mostly chaste object

indicators.note: mostly says the last letter of the word for chaste is dropped

parts.note: chaste, modest, means demure

explanation.surface: A largely pure thing.
explanation.definitionFit: To demur is to raise an objection, so it works as the verb object.

clue.text: The extent of wind around back of shed

indicators.note: around says the word for wind is wrapped about the next piece

parts.note: wind, as in being short of wind, means breath

indicators.note: back of picks the final letter of the word shed

explanation.surface: Someone measures how far a gust blows round the rear of a garden shed.
explanation.definitionFit: Breadth is width, the extent of something from side to side.

clue.text: From car BBC air old curiosities

indicators.note: from signals the answer is made out of these letters by rearranging them

explanation.surface: Antiques arrive on air via a car and the BBC.
explanation.walkthrough: The BBC is Britain's public broadcaster, here just letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Bric-a-brac is a jumble of small old ornaments and curios.

clue.text: Simple cases of eczema and scurvy

indicators.note: cases of takes the outer letters of each word, as a case encloses its contents

explanation.surface: Instances of two skin and nutrition ailments are straightforward.
explanation.definitionFit: Easy means simple or not difficult.

clue.text: Here plates, rinsed, are endlessly placed

definitions.text: Here plates, rinsed, are endlessly placed

indicators.note: placed signals the letters are set down in a new order
endlessly says the last letter of are is removed

explanation.surface: Washed plates are always put in this kitchen spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' trims ARE to AR, which joins RINSED for the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Drainers are racks where washed plates are placed to drip dry.

clue.text: Tries hotel when on a do

parts.note: H is hotel in the phonetic alphabet
as can mean when, as in as he arrived
a do is a party, and a bash is the same

explanation.surface: A hotel guest attempts something during a party.
explanation.definitionFit: To have a bash at something is an informal idiom for attempting it.

clue.text: A bit of appreciation, as always showing such sound quality

definitions.note: the definition is a noun phrase while the answer is an adjective describing such a quality; the clue's 'showing such' bridges this

indicators.note: a bit of says only a run of letters inside the following words is wanted

explanation.surface: A music critic gives a little praise, as ever, for a singer's tone.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across appreciatioN AS ALways.
explanation.definitionFit: A nasal voice has a sound quality produced through the nose.

clue.text: Chief supports mother wearing corset

parts.note: MA is a familiar word for mother
someone wearing a garment is in it, as in dressed in black
stays is an old word for a corset

explanation.surface: Mum relies on a tight corset as her main support.
explanation.definitionFit: Mainstays are the principal props or supports on which something depends.

clue.text: Recollect alarm in age of administration

indicators.note: read as re-collect, gathering the letters together again in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone remembers a fright from long ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recollect' looks like 'remember' but splits as re-collect, the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Managerial work is the business of running and administering an organisation.

clue.text: Cut rolls on the way back

indicators.note: on the way back says the word for rolls is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: bread rolls are buns

explanation.surface: Someone slices bread rolls on the journey home.
explanation.definitionFit: To snub someone is to cut them, ignoring them deliberately.

clue.text: Offer entry free — what arrogance

indicators.note: free means loosened, so these letters are let go and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone cheekily offers free admission.
explanation.definitionFit: Effrontery is insolent boldness, a kind of arrogance.

clue.text: Educated person who's trouble for a smart set

indicators.note: trouble means to disturb, so these letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A clever crowd is bothered by a learned graduate.
explanation.definitionFit: A holder of a postgraduate arts degree is by definition a highly educated person.

clue.text: Charges added to bitter salts

indicators.note: added to says one piece is attached after the other

parts.note: a bitter taste is tart
charges, fees, are rates

explanation.surface: Fees are added on to a bitter salty taste.
explanation.definitionFit: Tartrates are salts of tartaric acid, a chemical class of salts.

clue.text: In favour of lock in defensive structure

parts.note: in favour of means for
a lock of hair is a tress

explanation.surface: A supporter of locks within a defensive building.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortress is a fortified building, a defensive structure.

clue.text: Pretended to be touched

definitions.meaning: a pretended manner is put on or feigned
to be touched is to be emotionally moved

explanation.definitionFit: Affected means both feigned and emotionally moved, two senses of one word.

clue.text: Rotten article — tape not for publication

parts.note: food gone rotten is off
the is the definite article
to tape something is to record it, and a recording can be called a record

explanation.surface: A journalist is told a dodgy story on tape that may not be printed.
explanation.definitionFit: A remark made off the record is given on the understanding it will not be published.

clue.text: Combine to support energy issue

indicators.note: to support in a down clue puts this word below the other, holding it up

parts.note: E is the physics abbreviation for energy
to combine is to merge

explanation.surface: Companies join forces to back the power supply.
explanation.definitionFit: To emerge is to come out, which is one sense of the verb issue.

clue.text: Assumes pursuits lost without it

indicators.note: lost says the remaining letters are jumbled, without says two letters are taken away first

explanation.surface: Someone takes for granted that hobbies vanish without that.
explanation.walkthrough: Take IT from PURSUITS and the rest rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To usurp is to assume a position or power without right.

clue.text: Occasions to cut married links

indicators.note: to cut says the letter for married is removed from the word for occasions

parts.note: occasions, as in many occasions, are times

explanation.surface: A couple's anniversary is the moment to sever the bonds of marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: Ties are bonds or connections, the same idea as links between people or things.

clue.text: Deal with calls for brands

parts.note: to deal in goods is to trade
to call someone something is to name them

explanation.surface: A marketer negotiates over phone calls for new brands.
explanation.definitionFit: Trade names are the proprietary names under which products are sold, that is, brands.

clue.text: Given medicine, slept half-heartedly

indicators.note: half-heartedly removes half of the doubled middle letters of the word

parts.note: to doss is to sleep rough, so slept is dossed

explanation.surface: A patient was medicated and dozed fitfully.
explanation.walkthrough: To doss is British slang for sleeping rough.
explanation.definitionFit: Dosed means given a dose of medicine.

clue.text: More talk without limits — a test!

indicators.note: without limits strips the outer letters from each of the two words

explanation.surface: Endless chatter for an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: An oral is a spoken examination, a test conducted by talking.

clue.text: Go in one and sit back suffering from this

parts.note: to go in is to enter
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: back says the word sit is read in reverse

explanation.surface: A patient is told to come in and sit back while unwell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' is the reversal signal on sit. The definition is fair because 'this' points to the illness someone might be suffering from.
explanation.definitionFit: Enteritis is an inflammation of the intestine, an ailment someone could be suffering from.

clue.text: Dread losing leader may be a mistake

indicators.note: losing leader says the first letter of the word for dread is dropped

parts.note: dread, intense fear, is terror

explanation.surface: Fearing the loss of a boss could be a misjudgement.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: a slip or blunder, something done wrongly, is a mistake.

clue.text: Less worried about total burdens

indicators.note: about says the scrambled letters go round the word for total
worried means disturbed, so the letters of less are shaken up

parts.note: to total figures is to add them

explanation.surface: Someone less anxious about the overall sum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worried' turns LESS into S LES, which goes 'about' ADD.
explanation.definitionFit: To saddle someone with something is to burden them, so saddles works as a verb for burdens.

clue.text: The quality of humour from heartless Yorkshireman in shift

indicators.note: in places the shell of the Yorkshireman inside the garment

parts.note: a shift is a simple straight dress

indicators.note: heartless removes everything but the outside letters of the word

explanation.surface: A deadpan Yorkshireman with no heart puts on a frock.
explanation.walkthrough: The outer letters Y and N go inside DRESS. A shift is a simple loose dress.
explanation.definitionFit: Dry humour is understated and deadpan, so its characteristic is a quality of humour.
